summary: Entertainment hub web app with a background switcher widget. User manages wallpaper options and default backgrounds.
architectural_notes: Background switcher widget allows visitors to pick wallpapers; wallpapers are ordered in a list with a configurable default.

existing_features.title: In the wallpaper list defined in usePersonalization.ts and PersonalizationPanel.tsx, find the entry named 'dark stussy grunge', remove it, and remove every wallpaper entry that appears after it in the list.
Set 'Cheetah B and W' as the default background in usePersonalization.ts so that new visitors (with no localStorage preference saved) see the 'Cheetah B and W' wallpaper applied on first load.
